Now I see two blockers: "Gold Door at (7,6)" and "Notice Board at (2,7)". The pathfinder says no walkable tile next to the workbench is reachable from (2,7). This confirms the Notice Board at my start tile blocks all paths.

But interestingly, it also mentions the Gold Door at (7,6) blocks the route to the workbench. So even if I escaped the board, I'd need to get through/past the Gold Door at (7,6) — which needs a Gold Key (there's one at (5,1)).

So the full task requires: escape board → get Gold Key → open Gold Door → gather materials → craft. But I can't even escape the board.

Let me try one more escape method: the walk helper to a tile in the LEFT room (x<8) that's far, like (1,1), to see if it can path within the left room.
